method: online = our live lookup queries the official source itself, without a key, login or captcha, and keeps the exact response (SHA-256, timestamped in Bitcoin). manual = the official source exists but only as a form, viewer or paid extract; we link it and a person checks it. needs_key = an official API exists and we are waiting for credentials. site_visit = what no register can show (the plot, the works, the people) and needs a local agent.

online.what: Cadastral record by reference: address, use, built area, plot area, year built
Cadastral parcel nearest to map coordinates

manual.source: BORME (daily bulletin, no name search API)
The town hall (ayuntamiento) of the municipality

site_visit: Works match the licence and the cadastral record

online.what: NYC address to tax lot (BBL) and building (BIN)
NYC tax lot: floors, building area, use, year built, owner company
NYC building permits by address or job number
online.source: NYC DOB Permit Issuance and DOB NOW approved permits (NYC Open Data)

online.what: Miami-Dade County building permits by address or permit number

manual.what: City of Miami and Miami Beach permits (own building departments)

site_visit: Sales office and escrow agent identity

manual.source: Dubai Land Department project status enquiry (captcha)

site_visit: Site progress against the DLD completion percentage

manual.source: BHUMI, ATR/BPN (viewer only, no public API)
GISTARU RDTR interactive map, Ministry of ATR/BPN

site_visit: Land certificate original at the BPN office or with a notary (PPAT)
Plot location and zoning on the ground
Works and the actual developer on site

online.what: Domain registration date and registrar of the project website
Developer company in the global LEI index
Images reused from other tracked projects (hashes from your browser)
